title: Bluetooth connection issues AAPS 3.2.0.4 and Accu-Chek Insight pump and with Dexcom G7 CGM (Samsung A54B with Android 14)
symptom: The user reports frequent Bluetooth connection issues between AAPS and the Accu-Chek Insight pump, and also with Dexcom G7 CGM. The problem seems more severe with Android 14, especially after a Samsung security update. An example shows a loss of connection for about 22 minutes despite the phone being close to the pump.
fix: The issue was resolved by using Samsung phone optimizations such as Good Guardians and Galaxy app booster, as suggested on dontkillmyapp.com/samsung. The user could not reproduce the issue after applying these optimizations.
evidence_quote: The issue has been resolved with one of the optimazations of the phone such as Good Guardians or Galaxy app booster. See more tips at https://dontkillmyapp.com/samsung
